# Hajiyun API (哈基云)

> Hajiyun API (https://hajiyun.top) is a universal LLM API relay and gateway platform. Designed for software development, AI translation, application integration, and AI workflows. Standard OpenAI Chat Completions compatible endpoint with native streaming and transparent token metering.

- Website: https://hajiyun.top
- Multilingual Portals:
  - English: https://hajiyun.top/en/
  - Русский (Russian): https://hajiyun.top/ru/
  - 日本語 (Japanese): https://hajiyun.top/ja/
  - 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese): https://hajiyun.top/zh-tw/
  - 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese): https://hajiyun.top/zh/
  - Tiếng Việt (Vietnamese): https://hajiyun.top/vi/
  - Français (French): https://hajiyun.top/fr/
- Multilingual Practical Guides:
  - Japanese: https://hajiyun.top/ja/guide/
  - French: https://hajiyun.top/fr/guide/
  - Vietnamese: https://hajiyun.top/vi/guide/
- API Base URL: https://hajiyun.top/v1
- Protocol: OpenAI Chat Completions Compatible (`/v1/chat/completions`)
- Maintainer: 0xdcc (https://x.com/0xdcc)

## Key Features & Highlights
- **Transparent Forwarding**: Requests are forwarded per published service and privacy policies without arbitrary manipulation.
- **Universal OpenAI Chat Completions**: Standard `/v1/chat/completions` schema works across compatible developer frameworks and tools.
- **Optimized Routing & Streaming**: Direct SSE streaming architecture for responsive conversational flow.

## Supported Models
- Anthropic Claude Series (Check console for active models)
- Google Gemini Series (High throughput and multimodal analysis)
- OpenAI Series (General reasoning and conversation)
- DeepSeek Series (High efficiency reasoning models)
*Always refer to your active Hajiyun Console for exact live model IDs and rate quotas.*

## Quickstart (cURL)
```bash
curl https://hajiyun.top/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ***" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "YOUR_MODEL_ID_FROM_CONSOLE",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
  }'
```

## Multilingual FAQ
- **Compatibility with third-party clients?** Compatible with tools supporting custom Base URLs and OpenAI Chat Completions; specific features require testing.
- **OpenAI のすべての API と互換性がありますか？** 本プラットフォームの対応範囲は Chat Completions 形式です。他の個別機能は別途検証が必要です。
- **Доступен ли русскоязычный интерфейс?** Да, доступен раздел на русском языке по адресу `https://hajiyun.top/ru/`.
